method: Budget pass comes only from each original final report. Missing values remain null/absent. SQL and pool times include network/Node callback scheduling. Unique server commands are identified by the traced receipt write, not request bodies; dropped raw samples make that classification incomplete. Transaction spans are client-observed BEGIN→COMMIT/ROLLBACK, not pure lock/CPU time. Sampled PG wait counts are not exact durations. Unattributed time includes validation/serialization/scheduling, not pure CPU.

network.method: Synthetic per-TCP-chunk delay in both directions; coalescing/backpressure make actual query RTT variable. Not WAN or pure SQL execution time.
